evidence: Receipt schema v1.0 defines 8 required fields: module, phase, wave, timestamp, checks_run[], checks_passed[], evidence[], status (PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL). Extended by individual modules with domain-specific fields. Validated against JSON Schema draft-07. All core modules recipe through archive consume this schema. Extension pattern: base fields required, module adds its own top-level keys.
